prompt: Create a flat national flag illustration on a completely OPAQUE rectangular image. Every pixel must have an opaque colored surface, including white and green areas. Keep the background flag field visible. Solid flat colors with crisp straight edges. No transparency, no alpha cutout. The flag occupies the entire canvas. Kuwait. Canvas width:height 2:1. Three equal horizontal bands: green top #007A3D, white middle, red bottom #CE1126. Solid BLACK TRAPEZOID at left hoist, with its long vertical base spanning the full left edge; short vertical side at x=25% canvas width, from y=one-third to y=two-thirds. Top slanted edge joins top-left corner to (25%,33.333%), lower slanted edge joins bottom-left to (25%,66.667%). Black shape is a trapezoid, not a triangle. No emblem.

review.method: Codex visual inspection of actual rendered contact sheets; China, Canada and Nauru additionally viewed full-size.
review.note: Black hoist trapezoid with green, white, red horizontal fields.
review.limitations: Hoist trapezoid is slightly wider than official quarter-width construction; acceptable for identity-only illustration.
